scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,ui "tsx watch server/main.ts --config config.yaml --dev" "vite --config ui/vite.config.ts"
scripts.desk: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts && tsx server/main.ts --config config.desk.yaml
scripts.start: vite build --config ui/vite.config.ts && tsx server/main.ts --config config.yaml
scripts.test: npm run test:spec && npm run test:legacy
